# Transfer list (`transfer-list`)

Move items between two lists.

Group: Text inputs. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/text-inputs';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createTransferList` (types in `dist/web/text-inputs/transferList.d.ts`): `.mh-transfer`: moves items between two lists. Each `__panel` has a header with its count, an optional filter and a multi-select listbox: pressing an item toggles it, Space toggles the active one, Shift+arrows extend, Ctrl/⌘+A selects all, Enter moves the selection across and a double press moves one item. The `__actions` in between move the selection or everything shown. On narrow containers the panels stack and the arrows turn.

```ts
export function createTransferList(options: TransferListOptions): TransferListHandle;

export interface TransferListOptions {
  /** Visible label of the whole control. Without one, pass `ariaLabel`. */
  label?: string;
  ariaLabel?: string;
  items: readonly TransferItem[];
  /** Values in the target list. */
  values?: readonly string[];
  sourceLabel?: string;
  targetLabel?: string;
  /** Shown in an empty list (default "Nothing here"). */
  emptyText?: string;
  /** A filter field above each list. */
  searchable?: boolean;
  helper?: string;
  error?: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
  labelStyle?: 'label' | 'eyebrow';
  onChange?: (values: string[]) => void;
}

export interface TransferListHandle {
  el: HTMLElement;
  field: FieldHandle | null;
  /** The two listboxes. */
  lists: Record<TransferSide, HTMLDivElement>;
  getValues(): string[];
  setValues(values: readonly string[]): void;
  setItems(items: readonly TransferItem[]): void;
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}

export interface TransferItem {
  value: string;
  label: string;
  description?: string;
  icon?: IconName | string;
  /** Can't be moved either way. */
  disabled?: boolean;
}

export interface FieldHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  label: HTMLLabelElement | HTMLSpanElement;
  /** The described element (input, select, textarea or the control). */
  target: HTMLElement;
  setHelper(text: string | undefined): void;
  setError(text: string | undefined): void;
  setSuccess(text: string | undefined): void;
  /** Updates the counter: `3 / 40` with a max, `3` without. */
  setCount(count: number, max?: number): void;
  /** Dims the label and messages (the control disables itself). */
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createTransferList } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const status = document.createElement('p');
const cards = createTransferList({
  label: 'Dashboard cards',
  sourceLabel: 'Hidden',
  targetLabel: 'Shown',
  items: [
    { value: 'weather', label: 'Weather', icon: 'weather', description: 'Today and tomorrow' },
    { value: 'lights', label: 'Lights', icon: 'lightbulb', description: 'Every room' },
    { value: 'heating', label: 'Heating', icon: 'thermometer' },
    { value: 'music', label: 'Music', icon: 'music', description: 'Now playing' },
    { value: 'cameras', label: 'Cameras', icon: 'camera' },
  ],
  values: ['weather', 'lights'],
  onChange: (values) => (status.textContent = `Shown: ${values.join(', ') || 'none'}`),
});

document.body.append(cards.el, status);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { TransferList } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';
import type { TransferItem } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const cards: TransferItem[] = [
  { value: 'weather', label: 'Weather', icon: 'weather', description: 'Today and tomorrow' },
  { value: 'lights', label: 'Lights', icon: 'lightbulb', description: 'Every room' },
  { value: 'heating', label: 'Heating', icon: 'thermometer' },
  { value: 'music', label: 'Music', icon: 'music', description: 'Now playing' },
  { value: 'cameras', label: 'Cameras', icon: 'camera' },
];

export function TransferListExample() {
  const [shown, setShown] = useState<string[]>(['weather', 'lights']);
  return (
    <TransferList
      label="Dashboard cards"
      sourceLabel="Hidden"
      targetLabel="Shown"
      helper={`${shown.length} of ${cards.length} cards shown.`}
      items={cards}
      values={shown}
      onChange={setShown}
    />
  );
}
```
